findings.location: source.html — multiple Bible quotation paragraphs (e.g., Ecclesiastes 12:1 paragraph, Genesis 2:18-24 paragraph, Genesis 1:26-28 paragraph, Genesis 2:22-23 paragraph, Mark 10:8-9 paragraph, 2 Corinthians 6:14-15 paragraph, 1 Corinthians 7:39 paragraph, Genesis 1:28 paragraph, Genesis 9:1 & 9:7 mentions, 1 Corinthians 11:3 paragraph, Ephesians 6:1-3 paragraph, Proverbs 3:1-2 paragraph, Ephesians 5 multiple quotations, 1 Peter 3:7 paragraph)
findings.source_quote: All printed Bible quotations in source.html (for example: “Ecclesiastes 12:1 says, “Remember now thy Creator ... I have no pleasure in them.”” and the long Genesis and Ephesians quotations are shown in English in the source).
findings.suggested_fix: Render each printed Scripture quotation consistently in Arabic so the translation conveys the printed English quotations' content in the target language. Preserve verse references and verse numbering exactly as in the source (e.g., "الجامعة 12:1 يقول: «اذكر الآن خالقك في أيام شبابك...» (Ecclesiastes 12:1)") or place the exact English quotation in quotation marks followed immediately by an accurate Arabic rendering. Do not change verse numbers or attribute the passages to different books. Ensure the Arabic rendering follows the meaning of the printed English text word-for-word (not substituted with another Bible version). Examples to fix: replace the English block “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him... (Genesis 2:18-24).” with an Arabic rendering that conveys the same wording and keeps “(Genesis 2:18-24)” exactly as the citation.
findings.translation_quote: The translator left the biblical quotations in English (for example: ““And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him... (Genesis 2:18-24).”” appears verbatim in the translation).

findings.location: source.html — paragraph in section 2 (Leaving and cleaving)
findings.source_quote: “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or correct the stray character preserved from the source. The source English has a stray capital 'B' in “Therefore Bshall a man...”. In the Arabic translation that English quotation appears; either correct the English quotation to match the original verse without the stray 'B' or ensure the Arabic rendering is clean and does not include the stray character. Example: change ““Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother...”” to ““Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother...”” and render in Arabic accordingly.
findings.translation_quote: “Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

findings.source_quote: After printing all six articles in The Heartbeat of the Remnant, we will publish them in a booklet.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide presentation for the English title that appears inside the Arabic article-note. Either (a) keep the original English title in italics but add an Arabic explanatory parenthetical or translation (for clarity to Arabic readers), e.g.: The Heartbeat of the Remnant (The Heartbeat of the Remnant)، or (b) transliterate and/or translate the title into Arabic while also keeping the original in parentheses. Preserve the surrounding HTML tags and placement. This is a minor stylistic/clarity suggestion, not a doctrinal change.
findings.translation_quote: بعد طباعة جميع المقالات الست في The Heartbeat of the Remnant، سننشرها في كتيب.
